## Cost and state notes

- Iterated effects have a catalog default of 60 iterations. Runtime cost scales with canvas size and iteration count.
- Volume storage and work scale cubically with `volumeSize`; choose small values when exploring effects.
- Particle filters require an owning `pointsEmit`/state/`pointsRender` chain for meaningful standalone execution.
- Loop markers must be paired around the chain they repeat.
- External-texture effects require the named image input to be bound.
